title: cwf-anarchy-championship
label: Mr. X

won.source: SeVeN's own text: "Mary Frank: Here is your winner and NEW CWF Anarchy Champion, Mr. X!" (promotions/cwf/archive/seven-2003-02-01.html)

how: Three-way Anarchy Rules match against Starter and Hardcore Z, reduced to two when Starter was written out mid-match by an in-story lightning strike; pinned Hardcore Z with his own legs on the ropes.
note: The Redz()ne-2 card bills him "(Champ)" defending against Sean Manning in a Dumpster Match on 11 March 2003 (per the fed's own event calendar; its own Redz()ne page dates the same card 3/11/03 — see that show's own date note), but the card's own results were never captured, so whether the reign continued past that night is unknown.

title: cwf-world-championship
label: 'The Natural' Mike Diamond

won.source: SeVeN's own text: Diamond makes Paco tap to the Midas Touch and is "awarded the CWF heavyweight title" (promotions/cwf/archive/seven-2003-02-01.html)

how: Beat Paco via submission to the Midas Touch, special guest referee 'Hollywood' Chris Harris; billed the promotion's first heavyweight champion since 2001.
note: Immediately after the pin, a returning, unmasked Kid Gangster attacked Diamond and produced a signed contract forcing a title match against owner Hellfire X. The Redz()ne-2 card instead bills Diamond tagging alongside Hellfire X against Kid Gangster and Hardcore Z; whether the promised singles title match ever took place is not attested anywhere in the surviving record.
